cim: Digital Realty Earnings: Artificial Intelligence Drives Record New Leasing and Strong Pricing Power
cim_eredeti: Digital Realty Earnings: Artificial Intelligence Drives Record New Leasing and Strong Pricing Power
szoveg_eredeti: Digital Realty raised its 2026 earnings outlook after third-quarter revenue rose 21% to $1.9 billion and core funds from operations per share grew 11% to $2.10, as the data center operator posted a record $627 million in new leasing bookings amid strong demand for AI infrastructure.
